column_definitions: Gene symbol. Select the linked symbol to open the corresponding GeneCards page.
Natural logarithm of the mean counts per million (CPM) across all pseudobulk observations plus one.
Log2 fold change comparing mean CPM among observations classified as Dementia with mean CPM among observations classified as No dementia.
Log2 fold change comparing Dementia and No dementia observations after excluding zero-expression values within each dementia-status group.
Region-of-interest label with the highest mean CPM for the gene.
Log2 fold change comparing the maximum ROI mean CPM with the arithmetic mean of the ROI-level mean CPM values.
ROI log2 fold change calculated from mean CPM values after excluding zero-expression observations within each ROI.
Cell subclass with the highest mean CPM for the gene.
Log2 fold change comparing the maximum subclass mean CPM with the arithmetic mean of the subclass-level mean CPM values.
Subclass log2 fold change calculated from mean CPM values after excluding zero-expression observations within each subclass.
Indication of what type of gene this is (from BioMart).
Fraction of all cells expressing the gene calculated as the total number of expressing cells divided by the total number of cells across all pseudobulk observations.
Difference in the fraction of cells expressing the gene between Dementia and No dementia observations. Positive values indicate higher detection in the Dementia group.
Region-of-interest label with the highest fraction of cells expressing the gene.
Difference between the highest ROI-level fraction of cells expressing the gene and the arithmetic mean of the ROI-level fractions.
Cell subclass with the highest fraction of cells expressing the gene.
Difference between the highest subclass-level fraction of cells expressing the gene and the arithmetic mean of the subclass-level fractions.
